blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the 9th term of the harmonic sequence: \(\frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{5}, \frac{1}{7}, \dots\)
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle yeh samajh lein ke harmonic sequence (H.P.) hai kya: aisi list jis ki har term ka reciprocal (ulta, yani 1 upar wo number neeche) lein to A.P. ban jaye.
Find kya karna hai? Is H.P. ki 9th term.
Plan: H.P. ka apna koi \(a_n\) formula nahi hota, is liye hum reciprocals le kar A.P. mein kaam karenge, wahan 9th term nikalenge, aur aakhir mein phir ulta kar denge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: H.P. \(\frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{5}, \frac{1}{7}, \dots\)
Humein find karna hai: is ki 9th term.
Tareeqa: H.P. ke sawal teen qadam mein hal hote hain: reciprocal lo, A.P. mein kaam karo, phir reciprocal wapas lo. A.P. mein \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) use hoga.

Reciprocals likhein
\[3, \; 5, \; 7, \; \dots\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{3}\) ko ulta karein to 3, \(\frac{1}{5}\) ka 5, \(\frac{1}{7}\) ka 7. H.P. ki definition hi yeh hai ke yeh reciprocals A.P. mein hon, aur waqai 3, 5, 7 barabar 2, 2 barh rahe hain.

A.P. ka \(a_1\) aur \(d\) nikalein
\[a_1 = 3\]
\[d = 5 - 3 = 2\]
Kyun: Common difference kisi bhi term mein se pichhli term minus kar ke milta hai. \(7 - 5 = 2\) bhi wohi de raha hai, is liye A.P. pakki hai.

A.P. ki 9th term
\[a_9 = a_1 + 8d\]
\[= 3 + 8(2) = 19\]
Kyun: Pehli term se 9th term tak 8 qadam hain (9 nahi), aur har qadam 2 ka hai.
Dhyan dein: Yeh 19 abhi H.P. ki term nahi, A.P. ki term hai. Bahut se bachche yahin ruk jate hain.

Wapas H.P. mein jayein
\[\text{H.P. ki 9th term} = \dfrac{1}{19}\]
Kyun: H.P. ki har term apni A.P. wali term ka reciprocal hoti hai, is liye 19 ko ulta kar diya. Yeh aakhri qadam bhoolna sab se aam ghalti hai.
Tasdeeq: A.P. ko aage likhein: 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19. Nauvein number par 19 hai, to H.P. mein nauvein jagah \(\frac{1}{19}\) aayega. Answer key bhi \(\frac{1}{19}\) deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the 9th term of the harmonic sequence: \(-\frac{1}{5}, -\frac{1}{3}, -1, \dots\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi H.P. hai, bas terms negative hain. Ghabrane ki zaroorat nahi, tareeqa bilkul wohi hai.
Find kya karna hai? 9th term.
Plan: reciprocals le kar A.P. banayein, us ki 9th term nikalein, phir ulta karein. Sirf signs ka khayal rakhna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: H.P. \(-\frac{1}{5}, -\frac{1}{3}, -1, \dots\)
Humein find karna hai: 9th term.
Tareeqa: Reciprocals ki A.P. aur \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\), phir reciprocal.

Reciprocals likhein
\[-5, \; -3, \; -1, \; \dots\]
Kyun: Reciprocal lene se sign nahi badalta; \(-\frac{1}{5}\) ka ulta \(-5\) hai. Aur \(-1\) ka reciprocal \(-1\) hi hai, kyunke \(\frac{1}{-1} = -1\).

\(a_1\) aur \(d\) nikalein
\[a_1 = -5\]
\[d = -3 - (-5) = 2\]
Kyun: \(-3 - (-5) = -3 + 5 = 2\). Minus minus plus ho jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Kai students \(-3 - 5 = -8\) likh dete hain; bracket aur sign ka khayal rakhein. \(-1 - (-3) = 2\) se tasdeeq bhi ho gayi.

A.P. ki 9th term
\[a_9 = -5 + 8(2)\]
\[= -5 + 16 = 11\]
Kyun: 8 qadam, har qadam 2 ka. Negative se shuru ho kar terms barhte barhte positive ho jati hain.

Reciprocal wapas lein
\[\text{H.P. ki 9th term} = \dfrac{1}{11}\]
Kyun: A.P. ki term 11 hai, to H.P. ki term us ka ulta \(\frac{1}{11}\).
Tasdeeq: A.P. likhte jayein: \(-5, -3, -1, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11\). Nauvein jagah 11 hai, to jawab \(\frac{1}{11}\). Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.
